notes: Account overview: large global e-commerce marketplace; building unified product search + recommendations pipeline.
Scale: goal is 500M vectors initial, spike to 1B+ over 9 months. Current ingestion cadence: 2M items/day with nightly re-embeds.

Primary technical asks: - sub-60ms end-to-end rerank P95 for single-query product re-rank (dense + cross-encoder fallback) - cost per query target <$0.00075 at 99M QPS-month equivalent - batch ingest pipeline with resumable checkpointing
Indexing: prefer hybrid sparse+dense; evaluating HNSW sharding strategies vs FAISS IVF+PQ; interested in Redwood's automatic sharding and hot-shard routing
Embeddings: will use smaller on-prem embedding model for initial vectorization, but needs runtime routing to hosted higher-quality embedder for cold-starts
Reranking: cross-encoder reranker only on top-40 candidates; want autoscaling to spin up GPU rerankers during peak traffic windows
Cost optimization asks: aggressive int8/4-bit quantization for embeddings, KV cache for popular prefixes, request for unit economics calc (tokens, GPU-hours, storage per vector)
Operational constraints: EU data residency for customer subset, strict retention controls for PII, SSO/SAML with SCIM; weekly audit log export to customer S3
Security: customer engineering said 'we need key-level separation between embeddings and metadata stores' — infosec flagged encryption-in-use questions
POC goals: ingest 300M sample vectors, demonstrate 99th percentile rerank latency under realistic traffic (diurnal pattern), and deliver a cost-per-query model for finance
